result:
Admins can now pin and unpin a discussion from its page, and the list shows pinned discussions first with a "Pinned" badge. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

The last lint hook error on `pin-discussion.tsx` came from the first of my two edits. After the second edit, the component no longer imports `useNotifications`. The hook did not re-run after that edit, so I have not confirmed it is clean.

All paths below are under `apps/react-vite/src`.

- **Mock API:** the discussion model in `testing/mocks/db.ts` has a `pinned` boolean. New discussions start unpinned. `testing/mocks/handlers/discussions.ts` has a new admin-only `PATCH /discussions/:discussionId/pin` endpoint that saves the state.
- **List order:** the list handler sorts all of the team's discussions with pinned first, then slices the page. Pinned items stay on top across pages, not only within page 1.
- **Types:** `Discussion` in `types/api.ts` has `pinned: boolean`.
- **API layer:** `features/discussions/api/pin-discussion.ts` has the request, the zod schema and a `usePinDiscussion` hook. The hook shows the success notification and refreshes the discussion and the list. I put the notification in the hook because the project lint rule requires it.
- **Pin button:** `features/discussions/components/pin-discussion.tsx` is a Pin/Unpin button wrapped in `<Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}>`. It sits next to "Update Discussion" in `discussion-view.tsx`.
- **Badge:** there was no badge component, so I added a small one at `components/ui/badge`. `discussions-list.tsx` uses it next to the title.

The seed data and the data generators do not set `pinned`. Older records read as unpinned because the handler treats a missing value as false.
